name: Aguni (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Aguni village emblem in yellow: a disc with a navy stylised letter C-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Aguni, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1981.

features.role: Aguni village emblem — a disc with a navy stylised letter C-shaped device
